value.signature: async fn install_generation (& mut self , input : & Generation , budget : ReadBudget , usage : & mut Usage) -> Result < bool , Error >

review.body: { generation :: install (self , input , budget , usage) . await }
review.item_premise: The first-generation writer borrows the protected Session and the caller-owned explicit declaration. One wrapped transaction locks history and sends only closed bounded statements. The existing shared meter admits index vectors, logical row delivery, strict validation and retained comparison; driver buffers stay within the declared trusted dependency boundary. Complete unchanged retry and local rollback are witnessed on the disposable server, while no result writer or executable storage is enabled. The operation returns only an inserted boolean and usage counters. Diagnostics remain owned by the shim and the wrapper.
